name: expense-tracker-mobile
description: Pocketful para Android: o mesmo front-end, com a lógica rodando no aparelho (SQLite) e sem precisar de servidor.

scripts.sync: npm run build && cap sync android
scripts.android:open: npm run sync && cap open android
scripts.android:apk:offline: npm run sync && cd android && .\gradlew.bat assembleOfflineDebug
scripts.android:apk:sync: npm run sync && cd android && .\gradlew.bat assembleSyncDebug
